description: This file provides a minimal Angular-like event emitter class, OutputEmitter, and a base class AngularLikeComponent that simulates component lifecycle methods for testing purposes with Vitest and jsdom.

classes.name: OutputEmitter
classes.description: A simple Angular-like Output event emitter class that manages a list of listeners and allows subscribing and emitting events.

classes.name: AngularLikeComponent
classes.description: An abstract base class to emulate Angular component lifecycle (mounting, destroying) and rendering, intended for testing in a simulated DOM environment.

methods.name: subscribe(listener: Listener<T>) { subscribe
methods.description: Allows a listener to subscribe to output events; returns an unsubscribe function.

methods.name: emit(value: T) { emit
methods.description: Emits a value to all subscribed listeners.

methods.name: mount
methods.description: Mounts (renders) the component into a specified container element.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Unmounts the component and cleans up.

methods.name: beforeMount
methods.description: Hook called before mounting; meant to be optionally overridden.

methods.name: afterMount
methods.description: Hook called after mounting; meant to be optionally overridden.

methods.name: beforeDestroy
methods.description: Hook called before destroying; meant to be optionally overridden.

methods.name: afterDestroy
methods.description: Hook called after destroying; meant to be optionally overridden.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to handle component rendering.
